owner: Northgrid Energy — Head of Customer Operations (fictional)
purpose: Answer domestic customer tariff questions and draft a recommended tariff for an adviser to approve.

affected_parties: Domestic energy customers, including customers recorded as vulnerable

risk.appetite: Very low for any action that changes a customer's tariff or price; low for advice reaching a customer unreviewed.
stop_conditions: Any tariff change executed without an adviser approving it
Advice reaching a customer recorded as vulnerable without human review
Tariff figures in a draft not matching the published catalogue
